definition_zh: 兽性的；野蛮残忍的；野兽般的；纵欲的；粗鄙堕落的
definition_en: cruel, brutal, or savage like an animal; of or relating to beasts
core_image: 披着人皮的野兽：外表是人，举动却露出獠牙
scene: 他夺走村民的粮食，还烧掉了磨坊，凶残得不像人类。The invaders committed bestial violence against the villagers.
sceneCN: 这里 bestial 是「野蛮残忍的、兽性的」（第 1 个义项：行为残暴如野兽）；句意是入侵者对村民施加了野兽般的暴行。

pos.zh: 兽性的；残忍的；野兽般的

derivatives.zh: 同源名词，义为「野兽；凶残的人」，bestial 由其派生
bestial 加名词后缀 -ity，义为「兽性；残忍」
bestial 加副词后缀 -ly，义为「野兽般地」
中世纪动物寓言集，同源于拉丁语 bestia

senses.title: Cruel and brutal like an animal
senses.definition: showing cruelty or violence that seems more animal than human
senses.definitionCN: 表现出更像野兽而非人类的残忍或暴力
senses.example: The invaders committed bestial violence against the villagers.
senses.exampleCN: 入侵者对村民施加了野兽般的暴行。
senses.why: Latin bestia names the beast, so the core image is a human acting with a beast's ferocity.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 bestia 指野兽，核心意象是人露出野兽般的凶残。

senses.title: Of or relating to beasts
senses.definition: belonging to or characteristic of animals rather than humans
senses.definitionCN: 属于野兽的，或具有野兽特征的
senses.example: The cave wall showed a bestial figure with horns.
senses.exampleCN: 洞穴壁上画着一个带角的野兽形象。
senses.why: The oldest sense simply points at the beast itself before any judgment of cruelty.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项只是指野兽本身，尚无残忍的贬义。

senses.title: Driven by instinct, not reason
senses.definition: governed by appetite or instinct instead of human reason
senses.definitionCN: 受食欲、欲望或本能支配，而不受理智约束
senses.example: Hunger reduced the castaways to a bestial struggle for food.
senses.exampleCN: 饥饿让遇险者们陷入争夺食物的兽性争斗。
senses.why: Beasts live by appetite alone, so stripping away reason leaves the bestial core.
senses.whyCN: 野兽只凭欲望生存，失去理智便只剩兽性内核。

senses.title: Carnal or lustful
senses.definition: expressing crude or excessive sexual appetite
senses.definitionCN: 表现出粗俗或过度的性欲
senses.example: The old play warns against a bestial surrender to desire.
senses.exampleCN: 这出老戏告诫人们不要纵欲无度。
senses.why: Carnal appetite is the animal side of human nature, hence the beast label.
senses.whyCN: 肉欲被视为人性中属于动物的一面，故以野兽相称。

senses.title: Savage in sound or manner
senses.definition: having a raw, animal quality of sound or bearing
senses.definitionCN: 声音或举止带有原始的、野兽般的质感
senses.example: He answered with a bestial growl.
senses.exampleCN: 他兽性大发地吼着回应。
senses.why: The beast image extends from deeds to voice and manner.
senses.whyCN: 野兽的意象从行为延伸到声音和姿态。

senses.title: Degraded and disgusting
senses.definition: shockingly low, filthy, or degrading in condition or conduct
senses.definitionCN: 处境或行为低下、肮脏、令人不齿
senses.exampleCN: 囚犯们忍受着非人的生活条件。
senses.why: To live like a beast is to fall beneath ordinary human dignity.
senses.whyCN: 像野兽一样生活，就是跌到人类尊严之下。

senses.title: Greedy and insatiable
senses.definition: marked by a crude, uncontrolled greed
senses.definitionCN: 表现出粗野失控的贪婪
senses.example: A bestial greed for land drove the expansion.
senses.exampleCN: 对土地的野兽般的贪婪推动了扩张。
senses.why: A beast devours without measure, so unbounded greed reads as bestial.
senses.whyCN: 野兽吞食毫无节制，无度的贪婪便被形容为兽性。

senses.title: Dull and brutish (archaic)
senses.definition: lacking human intelligence or feeling, stupid like a beast
senses.definitionCN: 缺乏人类的智慧或情感，愚钝如兽（旧用法）
senses.example: In the old text, the bestial man cannot rise to moral thought.
senses.exampleCN: 在旧文本中，愚钝如兽的人无法进行道德思考。
senses.why: Early writers saw beasts as mindless, so the word once stressed dullness.
senses.whyCN: 早期作家认为野兽无心智，故该词曾有愚钝之义。

intro.en: Bestial comes straight from the Latin word for beast.
intro.cn: bestial 直接来自拉丁语中「野兽」一词。

items.en: bestia meant beast, wild animal; its deeper origin is uncertain, possibly borrowed from an older Mediterranean language.
items.cn: 拉丁语 bestia 意为「野兽、野生动物」；其更深的来源不确定，可能借自更古老的地中海语言。
拉丁语 bestialis 意为「野兽的、像野兽的」。

items.en: bestial passed into Old French with the senses of animal and brutal.
items.cn: bestial 进入古法语，兼有「野兽的」与「残暴的」之义。

items.en: English took the word in the 14th century, chiefly meaning brutal or carnal.
items.cn: 英语在 14 世纪借入该词，主要指残暴或纵欲。

items.en: today it stresses savage cruelty, with a technical sense in descriptions of animal nature.
items.cn: 如今它强调野蛮残忍，也可在描述动物性时使用。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the beast root; the near-meaning group gathers words for savage or animal-like conduct.
note.cn: 形近组共享 beast 词根；近义组汇集野蛮、兽性类词。

entries.definition: an animal, especially a large or dangerous one

entries.definitionCN: 动物寓言集——同源于拉丁语 bestia
兽性；残忍——bestial 的派生名词
野蛮的；残忍的；不强调动物意象
凶猛的；未开化的；兼有原始与残暴之意

entries.definition: in a wild state, especially of a tame animal gone wild
entries.definitionCN: 野性的；野化的；侧重动物回归野性

normalIntro.en: Bestial is beast plus the adjective suffix -ial.
normalIntro.cn: bestial 是 beast（拉丁 bestia）加形容词后缀 -ial。

normal.en: The root is Latin bestia, meaning beast.
normal.cn: 词根是拉丁语 bestia，意为「野兽」。

normal.en: The suffix -ial makes adjectives of relation.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ial 构成表示关系的形容词。

normal.en: Bestiary is the medieval book of beasts.
normal.cn: bestiary 是中世纪的动物寓言集。
bestiality 指兽性的、残忍的行为。

normal.en: Beast itself came through Old French beste.
normal.cn: beast 本身经古法语 beste 进入英语。

abstract.en: See a man in a suit whose shadow has claws.
abstract.cn: 看一个穿西装的人，影子却长着利爪。

abstract.en: Feel the roar come from a human throat.
abstract.cn: 感受吼声从人的喉咙里发出。

abstract.en: Picture appetite running without any rein of reason.
abstract.cn: 想象欲望脱缰狂奔，理智毫无约束。

examples.en: The invaders committed bestial violence against the villagers.
examples.cn: 入侵者对村民施加了野兽般的暴行。

examples.en: Hunger reduced the castaways to a bestial struggle for food.
examples.cn: 饥饿让遇险者们陷入争夺食物的兽性争斗。
囚犯们忍受着非人的生活条件。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「白兽」——表面上白白净净是个人，内里却是头白毛野兽，兽性大发。

root: 拉丁语 bestia「野兽」（更深来源不确定，可能借自更古老的地中海语言）加形容词后缀 -alis；经古法语 bestial 进入中古英语，义为「野兽的、残暴的」，现代英语强调兽性的残忍与堕落。

sensesIntro.en: From simply belonging to beasts, the word grows into cruelty, appetite, degradation, and even old senses of dullness.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「属于野兽」出发，词义长出残忍、欲望、堕落乃至旧义的愚钝。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a human being with the face of a beast
core.cn: 核心意象：长着野兽面孔的人

intro.en: Bestial is built on the Latin beast root with a relational adjective suffix.
intro.cn: bestial 建立在拉丁语「野兽」词根加关系形容词后缀之上。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 bestia 词族及后世同源词。
